title: Joseph's Dream
paragraphs: Joseph was a carpenter engaged to Mary. When he learned she was expecting a baby, he was heartbroken and puzzled. He was a gentle, good man, and he planned to quietly end the engagement so she would not be shamed. But in the night, in a dream, an angel told him not to be afraid to take Mary as his wife, because the child was from God. He was to call him Jesus, because he would save his people. Joseph woke up and did exactly that. He never says a word in the Gospels, but what he does speaks loudly. He stays, he protects, he trusts. The prophet's old word comes true: Immanuel, "God with us."
wonder: I wonder what Joseph felt when he woke up from that dream?
activity: Do a quiet act of kindness today without telling anyone.
prayer: God, make us gentle and brave like Joseph, ready to protect and care for those who need us. Amen.
alt: A sleeping carpenter dreams of a small golden star and cradle drawn in a thread of light.
hidden: A tiny saw or hammer in a corner.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
